author: potuz
content:
So the design for this is that the EL will verify the XMSS signature, any SPHINCS account will send a tx with a proof of posession of the validating XMSS key and call the contract. The EL verifies that the signature is good and queues it and then the EL consumes the requests and exits the validator.

Alternatively the XMSS signature can be checked in the CL, but this will incurr a lot more waste: we need to keep the full signature on the EL and then pass the full data on requests. 

So this effectively seems to me that it means that the EL needs to do this verification. 

I still think this is a functionality that is important enough to keep

author: potuz
content: BTW: I definitely prefer this design Kev than the current CL message on a global topic
